tracePolicy: Every parent requirement, invariant, success criterion, and named legacy regression maps to at least one fixture case; every fixture case carries at least one trace.

traces.requirement: Previous/next, play/pause, global Stop, and separate Restart controls with exact state-machine matching on every input modality.
Accessible exact scrubber: slider role, keyboard seek law, exact rational labels, pointer scrub preserved.
traces.parentSource: U4 required implementation and success criteria

traces.requirement: Truthful locked/ready/playing/paused/interrupted/unavailable/fault presentation from the accepted projection only.
Stale generation/sequence/request notifications cannot repaint controls; the display sweep writes nothing back.
Space/Shift+Space with the frozen edit-field and modifier guards; every control reachable by keyboard.
Count-in and metronome toggles bound to X1 set-count-in/set-metronome with selector-truthful rendering.
Instrument and groove changes expose their effective boundary.
Loop scope: whole chart or exactly one armed section; ephemeral, pause-surviving, replacement-cleared.
Mobile bottom bar remains visible and safe-area correct across the required viewport and pointer cells.
The initial UI never falsely reports playing.
Stop settles with zero post-stop attacks and the playhead returns to run start; the UI frame follows the accepted stop notification.
traces.parentSource: REBUILD_PLAN L-AUDIO-01 as it presents in UI

traces.requirement: Init/rapid-instrument races surface as truthful boundary state, never as stuck or lying controls.
